question: When was Coal India Limited came into existence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Coal India Limited (CIL) was founded in November 1975 by the Government of India.
 
• It operates in the coal mining industry and has its headquarters in Kolkata, India.
 
• CIL is the world's largest coal mining company.
 
• It operates in 83 mining areas across eight Indian states, managing 322 mines.
 
• CIL also runs workshops, hospitals, training institutes, and vocational training centers.
